scope_description.value: Renovation of portions of Building NH-95 at NSA Hampton Roads for the US Second Fleet (C2F) Command. Work includes MEP systems renovation across first and second floors: reconfiguration of existing dual-duct VAV systems; demolition of Data Center CRAC units with new VAV system in former data center areas; new DDC controls; 36" range exhaust hood for Admiral's cook staff galley; new restroom facilities; demolition and replacement of all electrical distribution, lighting, and communications systems; new LED lighting, occupancy controls, power distribution; and new secure/non-secure telecom systems including fiber/copper and an EF/POP room meeting ICD 705 requirements. Hazardous material abatement (ACM, lead paint, PCB ballasts) required.
scope_description.source: SAES Rev18C §A2; Mechanical BOD p.1; Electrical BOD; Plumbing BOD
